dataflow_evidence.program_source_why: the firmware derives DSP_PC_START from this block address; the block content, its executability and the execution mechanism (flash alias vs copy vs ROM) are unproven
dataflow_evidence.block_content_validation: NONE: the block is not decoded as DSP instructions; no opcode/structure check exists

limitations: abs24 cannot encode the >24-bit windows (maximum 0xFFFFFF); the direct-absolute pass is a low-alias completeness check only
pair tracking follows only movd $imm:l bases; base arithmetic (addd/subd), r12/r13 indexing and indirect pointers are not modelled
DMA or hardware copy engines are not visible to this scan
